description: The sloshing tank (0.6 x 0.6 m, the surface tilted 0.27-0.33 m) on a level 0 of 2 cm with three refined levels (G 1 3, down to 2.5 mm): a static band z 0.28-0.30 m on the finest level, the coarser levels nested around it, so the surface runs through the top of levels 3 and 2. One interface width on all levels (G 28 3) and G 17 1. To 1 s the largest velocity is 0.31 m/s (1.07 m/s without G 17; 0.29 m/s on one grid of 2.5 mm).
covers: G 17 1 with three refined levels: the start of the coarse column on every level
